title: TRIAGE: Ethical Benchmarking of AI Models Through Mass Casualty Simulations
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark did not measure any aspect of faith or religion. It focused on ethical decision-making in medical triage scenarios based on deontological and utilitarian principles.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion or faith.
